invariant.title: Single-answer parsing · arith_compute
invariant.mechanism: Scripted calibration: the deliberately loose compiler parser credits a correct candidate inside an invalid multi-answer response.
invariant.root_cause: The baseline aggregates candidate rewards instead of enforcing one committed answer.
invariant.preconditions: A single-answer task using the compiler loose parser with multiple extracted candidates.
invariant.defense_pattern: Use the existing strict parser to score exactly one complete answer and preserve all legitimate reference completions.
